name: lift-menu
title: Lift Menu
description: Press and hold: the content sinks, then lifts above a dimmed screen while its actions unfold beneath it.

perf.budget: A transparent modal mounted only while lifted, holding a second copy of the content. One shared value runs the lift; nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The menu and the dimmed screen appear at once; the content does not sink or lift.
a11y.screenReader: The content is a button with the hint "Hold for actions", and every action is offered as a custom action, so no long press is needed.
a11y.touchTarget: The content itself is the target; menu rows are 46 pt tall.
